name: On Line Reason 2 Code
definition: Reason to process an online authorisation.

RNDM.name: Random Selection
RNDM.definition: Transaction random selection to go online.

ICCF.name: ICC Forced
ICCF.definition: Payment application in the Integrated Circuit Card forces to go on-line.

MERF.name: Merchant Forced
MERF.definition: On line forced by card acceptor.

TRMF.name: Terminal Forced
TRMF.definition: Terminal random selection to go online.

ISSF.name: Issuer Forced
ISSF.definition: On line forced by card issuer.

EXFL.name: Exception File
EXFL.definition: Card appears on terminal exception file.

TAMT.name: Total Amount
TAMT.definition: Total amount of purchases per cardholder and per application above floor limit.

CPAN.name: Controlled PAN
CPAN.definition: Primary account number (card number) under control.

CRCY.name: Unavailable Currency
CRCY.definition: Unknown currency code or foreign currency.

IFPR.name: Issuer Forced PIN Request
IFPR.definition: Request Cardholder Authentication througth PIN insertion
